Halcyon Ridge Pharmaceuticals, Inc.
400 Larkspur Way, Suite 12, Fictionville, NJ 08000, USA

Date: [date of dispatch]

Re: IND 299001 - Ostrevia (lumiravostat) tablet, film-coated, 10 mg and 25 mg
eCTD sequence 0000 - original-application / application

Dear Review Division,

Halcyon Ridge Pharmaceuticals, Inc. submits this initial Investigational New Drug application for lumiravostat, to begin the first-in-human study described in the enclosed protocol.

The IND is provided in eCTD format (v3.2.2). Forms FDA 1571, 1572 and 3674 are in Module 1.1; the introductory statement and general investigational plan are in 1.20 and the investigator's brochure in 1.14.4.1. We understand that the study may not begin until 30 days after FDA receives this IND unless FDA notifies us earlier.

Contact: Dana Okafor, Director, Regulatory Affairs, +1 555 0100 220, regulatory@halcyonridge.example

Sincerely,

Dana Okafor, Director, Regulatory Affairs
